entities.summary: Christopher Paul Carney is an American politician who was the U.S. representative for Pennsylvania's 10th congressional district from 2007 to 2011. He is a member of the Democratic Party. Chris Carney was a writers & intellectuals from Cedar Rapids (b. 1959-03-02, Cedar Rapids). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
